verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents forwarding the business number to an external cell phone, or any away-from-desk or after-hours forwarding rule. Generic routing claims ("Route incoming calls to the right person", custom ring orders, call transfers, phone menus) and the Sona AI answering feature are adjacent call-handling features, not the forwarding capability this story asks for. Mobile apps ringing on a user's phone are also not forwarding the number to a cell.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk
